## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `.env.test` unreadable — a secret-read guard blocks reading `.env.test`; the database URL documented in `CLAUDE.md` / `docker-compose.yml` (`postgres://tasks:tasks@localhost:5432/...`) was used instead. Pre-flight therefore verified only that the file exists, not its contents.
- Concurrent sibling runs — wave-3 siblings (F05, F06, F08) were running `cargo test` and `task-api` processes against the same PostgreSQL server during this run; free ephemeral ports were used and no interference was observed.
